### Task0065 owner direct-chat authorization — source record (26 October 2026)

Codex records the owner's current direct-chat instruction, not independent identity attestation or agent approval: “I approve preparation and implementation of a narrowly scoped Task0065 to integrate Vellistry's existing 55 MFA tests into mandatory GitHub Actions CI.” Baseline a902fdb36bb51e17a5c567787c6886b171ca50fe reverified; Task0065 unused.

Authorized: new unique Task/committed validated immutable ContextPack before operative edits; run existing `pnpm test:auth-mfa` in the mandatory application job of `.github/workflows/ci.yml`; verify relevant Auth-source classification and final-gate failure propagation; preserve existing tests/security/PostgreSQL recovery/governance/workflow semantics; offline tests, distinct source review, exact-head CI and PR for separate owner merge. Narrow supporting static contract/regression paths are `scripts/pr_compliance.py`, `tests/test_ci_policy.py`, `tests/test_pr_compliance.py`, with current-state/Task/CP/EB/input/report/evidence/per-PR manifest records. No application, dependency, backend-policy, SQL, Supabase setting or credential changes.

No hosted Auth operation, MFA enrollment, deployment, automatic merge, production-gate promotion or remediation-delegation reactivation. Issue108 stays OPEN; R01–R08 NOT_RUN; N12/historical independent spawn EPERM BLOCKED; PRINCIPAL target assurance/SESSION and other unresolved security gates unchanged. Original Task0064 and all immutable/historical evidence preserved.
